title: Give the brief's focused test command without regex alternation, or as one command per test, so roles can run it under the one-command rule

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The ui reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261122-031627-c98e, project ork, item S400:

Give the brief's focused test command without regex alternation, or as one command per test, so roles can run it under the one-command rule

Evidence: the Check command `go test ./internal/tui -run 'FixRoundReal|EngineDetail|PackCells|RoadmapHeader' -v` cannot be run as written; an unquoted `|` in `-run` is denied as multiple operations
